security_audit.summary: The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package and uses API credentials from the execution environment or a local file. Most backtick alerts are Markdown, and no evidence of encoded payloads, audit manipulation, or intentional credential theft was found. The instructions also lack safeguards for shell arguments, token-bearing links, and billable requests.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval to install a reviewed, integrity-verified package version. Remove automatic latest-version downloads from authentication and lookup workflows.

remediation.issue: API credentials available to the CLI
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated, restricted credential and prefer an approved secret store. Pass only the necessary credential to the reviewed client and keep it out of logs.
Pass keywords and pagination tokens as literal arguments without a shell, or use the structured MCP interface.

remediation.issue: Unrestricted sharing of token-bearing note URLs
remediation.suggestion: Omit security query parameters from reports, logs, and forwarded links by default. Share original URLs only when needed and specifically authorized.

remediation.issue: Billing link taken from an error response
remediation.suggestion: Use the documented billing URL instead of a link supplied by an error response.
Require approval or a user-defined spending limit before billable calls, including pagination and retries.

content.user_title: Find Xiaohongshu Topics for Content Planning
content.value_statement: A trending topic does not always suit your audience or offer a useful content angle. Compare Xiaohongshu rankings with public note samples to choose topics and draft headline ideas.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the current Xiaohongshu hot list and report available rankings and popularity signals.
Search public notes by keyword and filter by publication window, note type, or engagement order.
Summarize sampled notes using available titles, authors, dates, and engagement counts.
Turn relevant trends into three to seven topic ideas with audience fit, content angles, and headline options.
Identify weakly supported topics and propose follow-up searches.
limitations: Live research requires a working SocialDataX CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
Analysis covers only the current hot list and returned pages, not the entire platform.
Publication dates and engagement fields may be missing, and date filtering cannot recover notes outside the returned pages.
The skill does not publish content, diagnose accounts, create covers, or guarantee traffic.

use_cases.title: Choose a topic for your next post
use_cases.description: Find current trends relevant to your audience and turn the strongest matches into practical post ideas.

use_cases.title: Plan a brand content calendar
use_cases.description: Compare trends against your audience and product category, then identify which topics fit an upcoming schedule.

use_cases.title: Review engagement patterns in a niche
use_cases.description: Compare public note samples by date, format, or engagement, and mark where the evidence is limited.

prompt_templates.title: Review the current hot list
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Check current trends before choosing a direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current Xiaohongshu hot list. Include rankings and available popularity signals. Stop after the hot list and do not search notes.

prompt_templates.title: Find examples for one topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Test an idea you already have.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for small apartment storage notes on Xiaohongshu. Focus on image notes from the past week and sort by likes. Report missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Build a shortlist from trends
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Use current trends to plan posts for a specific audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review current Xiaohongshu trends for first-time renters. Sample notes for two relevant themes. Suggest three post ideas with headline options, and explain which themes you would skip.

prompt_templates.title: Compare evidence for two directions
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Compare themes for an editorial meeting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare desk organization with small-space storage for remote workers. Use the same note format, publication window, and engagement sort for both searches. Seek approval before billable calls and limit each search to two pages. Separate observations from recommendations and flag incomplete results.

output_examples.input: Show the hot list signals that are relevant to renters. Do not search notes.
output: Rank 8: Small-space storage. Popularity score not available.
Suggested angle: Compare desk storage options that do not require drilling.
No note samples were requested. The ranking alone does not show whether the topic suits your audience.

output_examples.input: Use recent notes about desk organization to suggest post ideas for remote workers.
output: Sample signal: Before-and-after examples showed how renters organized cables without drilling. The sample does not establish a platform-wide pattern.
Suggested headline: Three ways to hide desk cables without drilling.
Suggested angle: Compare the setup time and tradeoffs of clips, ties, and under-desk trays.
Next step: Compare image and video notes before choosing a format.

best_practices: State your audience and content goal before requesting recommendations.
Use the same time range, note type, and sort order when comparing themes.
Set a page limit and agree on any service charges before expanding a search.
anti_patterns: Treating the hot list or a small note sample as evidence of platform-wide demand.
Comparing engagement counts without accounting for publication dates and note formats.
Pasting API keys into chat or assuming token-bearing note links are suitable for public sharing.

faq.question: Do I need a keyword to see current trends?
faq.answer: No. The hot list does not require a keyword, but searching related notes does.

faq.question: Do I need a Xiaohongshu login?
faq.answer: The documented workflow needs SocialDataX access, not a Xiaohongshu login. Use an authenticated MCP connection or configure the CLI credentials outside chat.

faq.question: Can a search use paid credits?
faq.answer: Yes. The authentication check is documented as non-billable, but data requests can use SocialDataX credits.

faq.question: Can I search only for recent videos?
faq.answer: Yes. Select video notes and a publication window. Results still depend on available dates and the pages returned.

faq.question: Are the returned note links ready to share publicly?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. The skill preserves original URLs, which may include security tokens. Check what a link contains before sharing it.

faq.question: Will this publish a post or predict how it will perform?
faq.answer: No. It suggests topics, headlines, and content angles. It does not publish posts or guarantee traffic.
